newsitem.title: USA: Kmart September same store sales fall.
newsitem.headline: Kmart September same store sales fall.

text.p: Kmart Corp said Thursday that on a comparable store basis, its consolidated sales fell 0.8 percent for the five week period ended October 2, 1996 over sales for the five weeks ended September 27, 1995.
September sales in U.S. Kmart stores decreased 0.2 percent on a comparable store basis over the same period.
Total sales from consolidated operations were $2.95 billion in September 1996, a decline of 2.2 percent from sales of $3.01 billion for the same period last year.

Sales from consolidated operations for the 35 weeks ended October 2, 1996 were $21.30 billion, down 0.5 percent from $21.42 billion for the first 35 weeks of 1995. On a comparable store basis, U.S. Kmart stores rose 2.3 percent for the same period.
"Kmart's sales performance remains below plan," said Floyd Hall, chairman and president.

"Although overall sales gains did not appear, we saw strength throughout the month in electronics and photography, while above average performance was produced by soft home, housewares, consumables, cosmetics, and pharmacy," he said.
Kmart operates 2,144 Kmart and 168 Builders Square retail outlets, and has 129 stores in international markets.
